main_text.p: Pafcha] Dies anniverfarius revivifcentis Chrifti. Magnus dies, Tac. Hebdomada renovationis. Quia, Christo in vitam redeunte, renovata sunt omnia.
Pascere] Servare pecudes, Ovid. Bubulcitare, Apul. Bubulcitari, Plaut. (Boves pascere.) Impascere, Com. (Compascere, vero est simul pascere.)
Pasci] Armenta per herbas pascebant, Ovid. Pascitare, Var. Pabulari. Impasci (i. in aliquo loco pasci) Col. Pecus carpit rura, Virg. (Compasci, vero est simul pasci, Var.)
Pascua] Pastio. Pecuria, pl. Cic. Compascuus ager, Id. Bucetum, Gell. Pascuum viride, Varr. Pecuaria loca, Sipont. Pecuaria, æ, Robert. Steph.
Pastinum] Pastinatio, Col. Culta nitentia. Enituit rudis campus vomere, Virg. Pectita tellus, Col.
Pastor] Pecuarius. Magister pecoris, Cic. Armentarius, Varr. Ad baculum, Propert. Armenti custos.
Pastoralis] Pastoritius, Cic. Pastoria pellis, Ovid. Bucolicus, Id.
Pastoralis ars] Pastoralis res. Pastoritia ars, res, Varr. Pastoritia scientia, Col. (Pastoratus, f. a.v.
Paterfamilias] Paterfamiliæ, Liv. Dominus in suis ædibus: in suos, Cic. Nostri majores, Dominum patrem familiæ appellaverunt; servos, familiares, Sen. Pater domûs, Hor.
Patet aditus] Patet domus, Ter. Patent valvæ, Cic. Reclusæ fores, Ovid. Interpatet meatibus & rimis pulmo, Macrob. Patefcit janua, Tibul.
Pati] Perpeti, Ferre, Sufferre, Vorare molestiam. Subire, Sustinere pœnam. Tolerare fortunam, Cic.
Pati æquo animo] Facilè pati; non molestè. Toleranter, tolera-

page.notes: Some words in the last lines are faint (e.g. "molestè" partly worn); the catchword "tolera-" is at the foot right. Italic Greek-free entries transcribed as printed.
